description:

**Position**
: Sr. OPEX Engineer - IMS/QMS

OpEx (Operational Excellence)

**Salary:**
₹50,000 – ₹70,000 per month

BE/B.Tech in Mechanical / Industrial / Production Engineering

Minimum 4 Years (at least 2 year in IMS or QMS implementation as a MR)

To ensure effective implementation of Integrated Management Systems (IMS) and strengthen organizational compliance through internal system audit activities.

* Conduct internal system audits as per audit schedules and standard requirements.
* Identify non-conformities and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Prepare audit reports and maintain audit-related documentation.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams for audit readiness and compliance improvement.
* Support in other OPEX / Continues improvement projects under the guidance of OPEX Head / Top Management.

* Strong knowledge of IMS standards and audit processes.
* Experience in customer and internal system audits.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Strong Communication, Presentation and coordination Skills.
* Problem-solving and process improvement mindset.
* Hands on experience in MS Office

**Certification: Lead/Internal Auditor certification of QMS / IMS is mandatory**

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Self-employed professionals in Kadi often collaborate with local manufacturers, service providers, and small businesses to support product and process quality. As an independent Quality Engineer, the focus is on helping clients establish reliable quality systems, improve operational efficiency, and meet customer and regulatory expectations. Engagements may range from short-term consulting projects to ongoing support, offering exposure to diverse industries and challenges. This environment provides opportunities for hands-on problem solving, direct client interaction, and measurable impact on product and service performance.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Quality Engineer role based in Kadi. The Quality Engineer will design, implement, and monitor quality processes to ensure that products and services meet defined standards and customer requirements. Daily responsibilities include developing and updating quality procedures, performing inspections and tests, analyzing data to identify trends or issues, and collaborating with production and operations teams to resolve nonconformities. The role also involves preparing quality documentation and reports, supporting root cause analysis and corrective actions, and advising clients on continuous improvement initiatives aligned with best practices and relevant regulations.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Quality Engineering and Quality Management, with the ability to design and optimize quality systems.
* Hands-on experience in Quality Control, including inspections, testing methods, and acceptance criteria.
* Practical knowledge of Quality Assurance, focusing on process adherence, documentation, and compliance.
* Experience ensuring Product Quality through specification review, defect analysis, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Analytical skills for data-driven decision making, including proficiency with basic statistical tools and quality metrics.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work closely with clients, production teams, and stakeholders on-site.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently, with strong organizational and time-management abilities.
* Relevant technical diploma or degree in engineering or a related field; certifications in quality (e.g., Six Sigma, ISO standards) are an advantage.

title: Assistant Manager Quality Assurance
description:
**Company Description**
Autoline Industries Limited is a leading automotive sheet metal component manufacturer in India, known for its integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing capabilities. The company supplies high-quality components to major global and domestic OEMs, including Tata Motors, Volkswagen, Ford, Daimler India, Ashok Leyland, GM, and Cummins USA. Autoline focuses on innovation, reliability, and customer-centric solutions, supporting complex vehicle platforms and demanding quality standards. Team members benefit from exposure to advanced manufacturing technologies and collaboration with renowned automotive brands, creating strong opportunities for professional growth.
  
**Role Description**
The Assistant Manager Quality Assurance is a full-time, on-site role based in Mahesana. This role is responsible for overseeing day-to-day quality assurance activities on the shop floor and within the quality department, ensuring that sheet metal components meet customer specifications and internal standards. Typical tasks include monitoring production quality, conducting inspections and audits, analyzing defects and root causes, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. The role also involves maintaining quality documentation, supporting process improvements, coordinating with production, engineering, and suppliers, and preparing reports for internal management and customer reviews. The Assistant Manager Quality Assurance will help drive continuous improvement initiatives and support compliance with relevant automotive quality frameworks and certifications.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of quality assurance methods, including in-process inspection, final inspection, and audit practices within automotive manufacturing.
* Candidates should possess skills in quality tools and systems such as SPC, control plans, FMEA, root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and documentation management.
* Candidates should possess abilities in reading engineering drawings, understanding sheet metal processes, and collaborating with design and production teams to resolve quality issues.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with automotive quality standards and certifications (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO 9001) and supplier quality requirements for global OEMs.
* Candidates should possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, along with attention to detail and a structured approach to process improvement.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and stakeholder management skills to interact with cross-functional teams, customers, and suppliers.
* Relevant academic qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field are preferred.
* Prior experience in automotive component manufacturing, particularly in sheet metal, in a quality or quality assurance leadership role will be an added advantage.

title: Senior Suppliers Development Engineer
description:
The Supplier Development and Maturity Engineer plays a key and highly strategic role in improving the maturity of Arabelle Solutions’ suppliers. The mission is to sustainably elevate performance, quality, and nuclear safety standards of industrial partners to secure critical projects in a demanding environment.
  
  
This role focuses on the structural development of suppliers, addressing the core elements that determine supplier reliability:
  
  

* Excellence of the Quality Management System
* Strengthening of nuclear safety culture and requirements
* Organizational and documentation robustness, including sub-tier supplier
* management
* Continuous improvement capability and risk control

The role is suited for a structured and rigorous engineer with strong quality expertise, mastering the industrial production process from order intake to delivery. With excellent interpersonal skills, the individual acts as a true change driver, supporting suppliers through a Lean approach.
  
  
Working closely with internal experts, the Supplier Development Engineer assesses supplier maturity by conducting audits, analyzing organization, and identifying risks and weak signals. Supported by sourcing strategy, he/she develops and leads high-impact development plans (including operational aspects), supports suppliers in transforming their practices, and ensures the effectiveness of implemented actions.
  
  
**The Suppliers Covered Include**

* New Arabelle Solutions suppliers
* Current suppliers with quality performance issues
* Strategic suppliers for the company

This role directly contributes to supplier panel maturity, nuclear supply chain reliability, and the success of Arabelle Solutions projects.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Contribute to and validate the global supplier selection strategy with sourcing teams
* Prepare, plan, and conduct assessment audits (ISO 9001, ISO 19443, customer requirements, internal standards) at supplier sites
* Evaluate and challenge suppliers’ organizational structure and processes to meet nuclear technical and administrative requirements; assess safety culture (organization, supply chain monitoring, competency management, process robustness, documentation control)
* Identify and mitigate gaps, weak signals, and risks affecting quality or safety
* Deliver structured and actionable reports
* Coordinate with internal technical experts for supplier-related actions
* Develop pragmatic and measurable supplier development plans (actions, deadlines, KPIs)
* Drive supplier maturity improvement through Lean coaching, follow-up, and effectiveness assessment
* Promote best practices while respecting confidentiality rules
* Develop and improve supplier qualification, maturity standards, and development programs, leveraging synergies within the EDF Group

**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**

* Training or certification in nuclear safety / ISO 19443 is a plus
* Minimum 10 years of experience in quality, audits, or supplier development, ideally in regulated industries (nuclear, energy, rail, aerospace)
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Strong command of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 required)
* Good understanding of nuclear safety culture
* Expertise in operational excellence in manufacturing
* Experience in QMS, organizational and process audits
* Strong knowledge of industrial production processes

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong leadership and change management capability
* Excellent communication, listening, analytical and synthesis skills
* Rigor, autonomy, and initiative
* Strong interpersonal skills with diverse stakeholders
* Proactive mindset

**Profile And Requirements**

* Engineering degree or equivalent
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); French is a plus

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Willingness to travel to supplier sites

title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description:
**Company Description**
Shivayom Innovation & Research Lab Pvt. Ltd. is a state-of-the-art pharmaceutical testing laboratory specializing in accurate, reliable, and compliant testing for pharmaceutical and chemical products. The organization is committed to ensuring product quality, safety, and regulatory compliance for its clients through precision science and robust methodologies. Shivayom delivers trusted results that support the integrity of products in highly regulated markets. The laboratory environment emphasizes advanced technology, strict adherence to standards, and continuous improvement in testing practices.

The Senior Quality Assurance Officer is a full-time, on-site role based in Chhatral, responsible for overseeing quality systems and ensuring adherence to regulatory and internal standards. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing and approving test methods and reports, monitoring quality control activities, conducting internal audits, and ensuring compliance with GMP, GLP, and other relevant guidelines. The role involves investigating and documenting non-conformities, coordinating CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions), and supporting validation and qualification activities for instruments and processes. * Proficiency in Quality Control and Analytical Skills to review data, interpret results, and verify compliance with specifications and regulatory requirements.

* Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical testing regulations, GMP/GLP standards, and relevant national and international guidelines.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Microbiology, or a related scientific discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in a pharmaceutical or chemical testing laboratory, preferably in a senior or lead quality role.
* Excellent documentation, reporting, and communication skills, with attention to detail and strong problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and provide guidance on quality and compliance best practices.

The candidate will be responsible for fabrication inspection, welding quality, material traceability, NDT coordination, and quality documentation in compliance with ASME Section VIII, Division 1 & 2, and applicable customer requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Carry out stage-wise quality inspections during the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and related equipment.

* Review engineering drawings, material specifications, approved procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs).

* Perform incoming material inspection and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, identification, and traceability.

* Conduct fit-up, dimensional, visual welding, and final inspections as per approved drawings and applicable code requirements.

* Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and welder performance qualification records.

* Ensure weld identification, material traceability, and inspection records are maintained throughout manufacturing.

* Coordinate NDT activities, including RT, UT, MT, and PT, as required by the approved inspection plan and applicable code.

* Monitor hydrostatic testing and other applicable pressure tests, ensuring approved procedures and safety requirements are followed.

* Coordinate inspections with Authorized Inspection Agency (AIA) representatives, third-party inspectors, and customer inspectors, as applicable.

* Prepare and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action records, and manufacturing quality documentation.

* Support preparation and review of the final manufacturing data report and quality dossier, including applicable ASME documentation and the Manufacturer's Data Report (U-1 or applicable form).

* Ensure inspection hold points and witness points are followed and properly released.

* Identify quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize rejection and rework.

* Support ASME U Stamp-related quality activities in accordance with the company's Quality Control System (QCS) and applicable code requirements.

* Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure timely inspection clearance.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or process equipment manufacturing.

* Practical experience in fabrication quality control and inspection of welded pressure equipment.

* Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1, and applicable material and welding requirements.

* Knowledge of welding inspection, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, NDT, dimensional inspection, and material traceability.

* Experience in quality documentation, ITP/QAP implementation, NCR handling, and final inspection.

* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in an ASME U Stamp-certified manufacturing facility.

* NDT Level II certification in applicable methods.

* Welding inspection certification such as CSWIP or AWS-CWI.

* Familiarity with ASME material traceability, pressure testing, and Manufacturer's Data Report documentation.

* Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.
